explain.en: If you unpack an idea or scientific concept, you explain it in clear detail.
explain.zh: If you unpack an idea or scientific concept, you explain it in clear detail.

explain.en: Unpack here means explain. Sonja explains that when our skin feels itchy, we scratch it, and that helps to get rid of parasites and other harmful things on our skin.
explain.zh: Unpack here means explain. Sonja explains that when our skin feels itchy, we scratch it, and that helps to get rid of parasites and other harmful things on our skin.

experience.en: And probably it's quite a good thing to experience rejection, even if it doesn't feel nice.
experience.zh: 而且，即便体验拒绝的感觉并不好受，但这可能也是件挺好的事。

experience.en: I asked you which rejection Walt Disney didn't experience before becoming successful?
experience.zh: 我刚才问你，Walt Disney 在成功之前并没有经历过哪种挫折？

experience.en: During the First World War, Britain experienced real food shortages .
experience.zh: 第一次世界大战期间，英国经历了真正的食物短缺。

experience.en: What this means is that an entire generation of British people grew up in a society that had experienced food scarcity and limited food choices.
experience.zh: 这意味着整整一代英国人是在一个经历过食物匮乏和有限食物选择的社会中长大的。

experiment.en: Yes. And she talks with psychologist Claudia Hammond about how she felt during the experiment.
experiment.zh: 是的。她还和心理学家 Claudia Hammond 探讨了自己在实验过程中的感受。

extreme.en: It only happens under extreme conditions, and there is only ever a tiny amount of fuel in the machine.
extreme.zh: 它只能在极端条件下发生，而且机器内部的燃料量微乎其微。

extreme.en: Deliberately looking for rejection might be an extreme way to become more confident, but it can lead to surprising discoveries.
extreme.zh: 故意寻求拒绝也许是建立自信的一种极端方式，但它可能会带来令人惊喜的发现。

extreme.en: Belgium wasn't even the most extreme example.
extreme.zh: 比利时甚至还不是最极端的例子。

exit.en: To quote him exactly, "It was a serious strategic mistake to exit nuclear energy… we simply don’t have enough energy generation capacity ."
exit.zh: 原话是这样说的：“退出核能是一个严重的战略错误……我们根本没有足够的发电能力。”

exist.en: It repealed the law completely, cancelling it as if it had never existed.
exist.zh: 它彻底废除了这项法律，将其撤销，就像它从未存在过一样。

exist.en: And with billions of people using AI, well, you get a level of electricity demand that didn't really exist five years ago.
exist.zh: 随着数十亿人使用人工智能，便催生了五年前根本不存在的巨大用电需求。

exist.en: If you only look at the dishes that existed in Britain in the 1940s, you’re gonna miss a huge part of what British people actually eat.
exist.zh: 如果你只看1940年代英国存在的菜肴，你将错过英国人实际吃的东西中极大部分。

extend.en: It announced it wanted to extend the lifespans of the ones that had already been prepared for shutdown, and it started looking at building new ones.
extend.zh: 它还宣布希望延长那些已经准备关闭的反应堆的寿命，并开始考虑建造新的反应堆。

extremely.en: And if we look at the other end of society, British food was actually extremely elaborate .
extremely.zh: 如果我们看看社会的另一端，英国的食物实际上极其精致。

extremely.en: Meat was cooked until it was extremely well done , partly due to misunderstandings about food safety.
extremely.zh: 肉被煮到非常熟的程度，部分原因是由于对食物安全的误解。

extremely.en: To maintain acceptable prices and reliable supply, countries started to admit that being able to produce your own energy was extremely important.
extremely.zh: 为了维持可承受的价格和可靠的供应，各国开始承认，能够自主生产能源极其重要。

excite.en: There is nothing that can melt down . That's a large part of why people are so excited about fusion: in theory, it offers something close to nuclear power's upside, of abundant , low-carbon electricity, without its biggest danger.
excite.zh: 没有任何东西会熔毁。这正是人们对聚变如此兴奋的重要原因：理论上，它既具备核能的大部分优势，能提供丰富、低碳的电力，又没有核能最大的危险。

exile.en: King Charles II, for example, before he was the king, spent time in exile in France during the English Civil War.
exile.zh: 例如，查理二世国王在成为国王之前，曾在英国内战期间在法国流亡。

extent.en: It’s something that didn’t happen to France or Italy or Spain, at least not to the same extent.
extent.zh: 这是法国、意大利或西班牙没有发生的事情，至少没有达到同样的程度。

exchange.en: People were told what they could eat. They were given a ration book, which gave them coupons to exchange for certain ingredients.
exchange.zh: 人们被告知他们可以吃什么。他们拿到了一本配给手册，上面有可以兑换特定食材的票券。

expectation.en: A lot of food culture is about habits and expectations.
expectation.zh: 很多饮食文化都与习惯和期望有关。

excellent.en: Britain also has excellent seafood. There’s also great meat in the UK, a lot of free-range animals.
excellent.zh: 英国也有极好的海鲜。英国还有很好的肉类，很多是散养动物。

excellent.en: There are some genuinely excellent ingredients available in Britain.
excellent.zh: 英国有一些真正极好的食材。
